snippet.title: Send Them to Hell - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Send Them to Hell - Official Trailer

Satan's forces are gathering to take over Earth. Gather your friends and jump into this chaotic co-op roguelike and brutally slaughter the forces sent to destroy you. Fight solo or team up with up to 3 friends as you battle endless waves or partake in a level based adventure mode. Upgrade your weapons, obtain powerful items, survive the onslaught, and prove that humanity isn't going down without a fight.
